input.label: feature
input.reply:
Thanks for the suggestion. This is a feature request: the UI currently shows the DOM snapshot as text in the error output (the "found multiple elements" case), and there's no rendered view or highlighting of matched elements.

I couldn't run an issue search from here, so I haven't ruled out an existing request. If you know of a related issue, please link it.

To help scope it, could you say whether you'd want:
1. a rendered preview of the DOM at failure time (an iframe or similar), or
2. only highlighting of the matched elements in the text output?

If the matched elements are exposed to the error (for example via Browser Mode locators), that would affect how feasible highlighting is. As a workaround for now, you can call `screen.debug()` or use `prettyDOM` and write the output to an HTML file, as you described.
